senses.gloss: setaka, adj. (= Pali id.; MIndic for śveta-ka, 〔§ 2.16〕), clear, pellucid, of water: nadīṃ … setakāṃ (mss. siketāṃ, em. Senart) sūpatīrthāṃ (Skt.; so read with parallel LV 〔248.9〕, and Pali sūpatittha, see below; mss. corrupt, wrongly em. by Senart) śucisaṃpannatoyāṃ syandamānāṃ dṛṣṭvā Mv 〔ii.123.20〕; the collocation setakā sūpatitthā, of a river or pool, occurs repeatedly in Pali, e.g. MN 〔i.76.28〕; 〔167.5〕; 〔283, last line〕.
*se-ti, for Skt. sīvyati, sews: gdve. setavya, MSV 〔ii.50.13, 15〕; inf. setum, ib. 〔50.16〕; see 〔§ 28.50〕 and Chap. 43, s.v. sīv (2).
